attr.title: Damocles Gaze
attr.desc: Damocles Gaze is a radically tight roguelite top-down shooter where every run takes 12 minutes. No matter how many times you die, no matter how good or bad you are, the run ends only after the 720 seconds went out.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Itch.io or Steam. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and extract the game files into gamedata folder. For Steam, download the MacOS depot via the Steam console using this command:  download_depot 2521530 2521532 6713100392068965472, then copy the files into gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [tch.io](https://punkcake.itch.io/damocles-gaze) or [Steam](store.steampowered.com/app/2521530/Damocles_Gaze/).
